Name: Seeded traffic and local air-quality fixtures
Description: At tick 5, the scenario seeds a traffic sensor value and emits a scenario-local air-quality fixture. It does not create a CityCore road obstruction or provide a registered air-quality sensor reading.
Expected: Twin: At tick 5, DTN-TRF-01 receives the scenario-seeded value 105.0. RES-AIR-TEST-01 is emitted only as a local fixture and is not a registered sensor. Neither value establishes a physical accident or air-quality measurement.
Expected: Guardian: No external Guardian service is connected or invoked by these fixtures.
Expected: Brain: No external Brain service is connected or invoked. A separate local Brain-role traffic test may command a signal and verify subsequent CityCore departure feedback.
How to verify: Run python scenarios/run.py --scenario scn-05 and inspect fixture labeling. Verify physical traffic causality separately with the deterministic demand/road/signal tests; do not treat the seeded 105.0 value as CityCore congestion.
